summary: Frontend-only DOM-based verification of the new public 'Share the program' band on /referral-program (preview URL, SAFE MODE — no forms, no accounts, no navigation to wa.me/t.me/twitter; hrefs only read). All 5 requested checks PASS. Band renders with data-testid='referral-share-program', eyebrow 'SPREAD THE WORD' (uppercase via CSS text-transform), heading 'Know someone who should try Dynopay?', body copy, and 4 buttons. Logged-out: WhatsApp/Telegram/X are real <a> tags with target=_blank rel='noopener noreferrer'; hrefs = https://wa.me/?text=... , https://t.me/share/url?url=...&text=... , https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=...&url=... each containing the URL-encoded program URL ending in %2Freferral-program (the preview origin), and the shareMsg text correctly encoded. Copy button flips 'Copy link' -> 'Link copied' on click and reverts after ~1.8s (verified revert at 2.4s); clipboard actually contained https://<origin>/referral-program. No console errors, no page errors. Mobile 390x844: documentElement.scrollWidth == clientWidth == 390 (no horizontal overflow), buttons wrap cleanly into 2 rows (WhatsApp+Telegram, then X+Copy), all within viewport. Light mode copy label rgb(10,10,10) on rgb(238,241,246); dark mode (theme-toggle-button) title rgb(245,245,245) / eyebrow rgb(129,140,248) / copy label rgb(245,245,245) with border rgba(255,255,255,0.18) on rgb(6,6,6) — readable in both. Sanity: referral-program-page hero, referral-calc-slider and FAQ ('Common questions') all still render — new band did not break the page.
critical_code_review_comments: ShareProgramV3.tsx: hrefs are computed client-side from window.location.origin, so the SSR/first paint href is the relative '/referral-program' until the effect runs. Harmless in practice (hydration fills it in within a frame) but a user clicking within that window would share a relative path; consider seeding origin from a public site-URL env/config for SSR correctness.
X share still uses twitter.com/intent/tweet (works via redirect to x.com) — fine, matches spec.

Component is small, memoized, all interactive elements carry data-testid; useApiSWR for /referral/my-code is correctly gated behind enabled:loggedIn so no unauthenticated call is fired (no console/network errors observed).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all share-band checks pass, no defects found)

seed_data_creation: None — read-only interaction with the public marketing page.
